new_scholarship.name: KU Leuven International Scholarship Fund
new_scholarship.duration: One academic year for a 60 ECTS master's programme, two academic years for a 120 ECTS master's programme; the flagship award is paid for a maximum of two academic years
new_scholarship.deadline: Application deadline 15 January 2026, 23.59 CET (2026-2027 academic year cycle).
new_scholarship.application_period: Applications open 15 October 2025 and close 15 January 2026, 23.59 CET for the 2026-2027 academic year.
new_scholarship.application_method: Separate scholarship application, not automatic on admission: step 1 submit a complete application file for an eligible master's programme with the KU Leuven Scholarships Candidacy Form uploaded as an annexe, step 2 register the scholarship candidacy in the online registration tool. One application gives access to all of the fund's master's scholarships; they cannot be applied for separately.
new_scholarship.description: The KU Leuven International Scholarship Fund is an alumni-donated fund that awards four named master's scholarships, the flagship being the Inspiring the Outstanding Scholarship for outstanding students from around the world. The Inspiring the Outstanding Scholarship gives a full KU Leuven tuition fee waiver plus an allowance of EUR 13,200 per academic year for a maximum of two academic years, with only an annual administration fee of circa EUR 140 payable; the holder does not pay living or travel costs. KU Leuven's own pages state that the fund supports pursuing a master's degree and that the award is available for master's and advanced master's programmes only, so it provides no bachelor's-level funding. Selection is by nomination from the master's programmes followed by a central KU Leuven selection committee, and only one award is available in the 2026-2027 cycle.
new_scholarship.best_fit: Outstanding applicants who have been nominated by a KU Leuven master's programme and who hold a previous degree from outside Flanders. Not applicable to bachelor's applicants.
new_scholarship.eligibility_summary: Open to all nationalities for the flagship Inspiring the Outstanding Scholarship; the three regional awards additionally restrict eligible nationalities. Applicants must be applying to a KU Leuven master's or advanced master's programme on the eligible-programme list, must have obtained previous degree(s) at a higher education institution outside Flanders, must not already be enrolled at a Flemish higher education institution (bar a narrow preparatory-programme exception), must not combine the award with any other scholarship, and must register a scholarship candidacy separately by the deadline. Bachelor's-level applicants are not eligible.

new_scholarship.selection_notes: After the deadline, each KU Leuven master's programme nominates eligible students who expressed interest; all nominees are informed by 10 March 2026 and asked for a one-minute motivational video, due by 18 March 2026. The central KU Leuven Selection Committee makes the final selection, with results announced at the end of March or the beginning of April. No numerical weighting is published for the criteria. Personal feedback is not provided because of the number of candidates.
new_scholarship.notes: SCOPE FINDING FOR THE COORDINATOR: this slot was assigned as 'KU Leuven International Scholarship' with the degree note 'bachelor eligible', but the awarding body's official pages show this fund is a master's-degree fund only, and the assignment's 'bachelor eligible' note could not be confirmed. Three official confirmations: (1) giving.kuleuven.be states the fund 'gives young talent from all corners of the world the opportunity to pursue a master's degree at KU Leuven' and lists four awards; (2) the scholarship database Programme filter at kuleuven.be/scholarships contains only Antwerp/Kortrijk bachelor programmes (Bachelor of Business Administration, Bachelor of Business Engineering, Bachelor of Engineering Technology, Bachelor of European Studies, Bachelor of Philosophy, Bachelor of Theology and Religious Studies) and no Leuven-campus bachelor programme; (3) the award page states 'Study level: Master's programmes' and that the scholarship is available for all master's and advanced master's programmes. BELGIUM MECHANISM DISTINCTION: 'reduced tuition fee' and 'scholarship' are different mechanisms at KU Leuven. This record is a scholarship and requires its own application in addition to the programme application; a statutory reduced tuition fee for students from developing countries is instead a nationality-based fee adjustment applied automatically on enrolment with no application, and it was NOT verified by a fetch in this session. AMOUNTS ARE AWARD-SPECIFIC: the EUR 13,200 per academic year figure is the flagship Inspiring the Outstanding Scholarship amount; the Africa, ASEAN and Central and South America awards have their own amounts which were not verified in this session, so do not universalise this figure to the whole fund. fully_funded is false even though KU Leuven describes the flagship award as fully funded, because an annual administration fee of circa EUR 140 and all living costs remain uncovered. The 2026-2027 cycle deadline of 15 January 2026 has passed, so status is closed; the 2027-2028 cycle dates were not yet published at the time of verification.

programme_detail_official.description: The KU Leuven International Scholarship Fund is an alumni-donated fund that awards four named master's scholarships, the flagship being the Inspiring the Outstanding Scholarship for outstanding students from around the world. The flagship award gives a full KU Leuven tuition fee waiver plus EUR 13,200 per academic year for a maximum of two academic years, with only an annual administration fee of circa EUR 140 payable, and it may not be combined with any other scholarship. KU Leuven states that the fund gives young talent the opportunity to pursue a master's degree and that the award is available for master's and advanced master's programmes only, so it funds no bachelor's programme. Candidates apply once: they submit a master's programme application with the candidacy form as an annexe and separately register their scholarship candidacy, after which programmes nominate and a central selection committee decides. Note for applicants comparing Belgian mechanisms: this is a scholarship requiring its own application, which is distinct from the nationality-based reduced tuition fee that KU Leuven applies automatically on enrolment to students from developing countries.
programme_detail_official.program_type: University donor-funded scholarship (full tuition fee waiver plus allowance), master's level only

Submit the complete programme application file with the Candidacy Form uploaded under document type 'Annexe'

common_rejection_risks: Applying at bachelor's level, which no award in this fund funds
Applying to a master's programme absent from the eligible-programme list
Submitting the programme application but forgetting the separate scholarship candidacy registration
Taking the English language test after the deadline
Already being enrolled at a Flemish higher education institution
Holding or being awarded another scholarship, since the award cannot be combined
Missing the 18 March video deadline after nomination, which is easy to overlook because it is not the main application deadline
estimated_uncovered_costs: Annual administration fee of circa EUR 140 remains payable despite the full tuition waiver
Living costs, housing, insurance and travel are not covered by the tuition waiver or the allowance
Books, materials and course-related travel budgets are not covered
The allowance is capped at two academic years, so any programme extending beyond that leaves later years unfunded

research_notes.degree_level_confirmed: Master's level, not bachelor's. The fund page on giving.kuleuven.be states the fund 'gives young talent from all corners of the world the opportunity to pursue a master's degree at KU Leuven' and lists four awards; the Inspiring the Outstanding Scholarship page states 'Study level: Master's programmes' and that the scholarship 'is available for all master's and advanced master's programmes at KU Leuven'. Independently, the KU Leuven scholarship database Programme filter at kuleuven.be/scholarships contains only bachelor entries for the Antwerp/Kortrijk university-college campuses and no Leuven-campus bachelor programme. The assigned degree note 'bachelor eligible' is therefore treated as wrong and degree_levels is recorded as Master's, with the coordinator warned not to insert this as a bachelor's scholarship without review. No substitution was made because the master's-only finding is itself the deliverable for this slot and a substitute award would need its own separate verification; research_notes.substitution is therefore null with this reason recorded here and in new_scholarship.notes.
